name.ja: BB戦士303 司馬懿サザビー

description.ja: ●三国伝シリーズに辣腕たる軍師“司馬懿サザビー”登場 ●武将モード、軍師モードの2形態へ組み換え可能 ●左手は特徴的な表情を再現 ●武器の“銀の牙”と“紅翼扇”は“牙翼の大剣”へ合体 ●他の三国伝キャラクターと兜、鎧、腕、脚、手の交換が可能
description.en: - Introducing the skilled tactician "Sima Yi Sazabi " in the Sangokuden series - Can be recombined into two forms: military commander mode and military commander mode - The left hand reproduces a characteristic facial expression - The weapons " Silver Fang " and " Red Winged Fan " are combined into the " Fangwing Great Sword" - Can exchange helmets, armor, arms, legs, and hands with other Sangokuden characters
